# Chi Pool: 1 + half the Soul Core rating, plus Techniques (Soul Cores give +0.5 chi).
ac_chi_pool = {
	value = ac_core_soul_rating
	divide = 2
	floor = yes
	add = 1
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_hidden_dragon } add = 1 }
}
ac_chi_available = { value = ac_chi_pool if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_chi_spent } subtract = var:ac_chi_spent } min = 0 }
